metadata.eval_name: Conway's Game of Life with Emojis

messages.content:
You are an expert JavaScript programmer. Write a single JavaScript function that implements Conway's Game of Life with advanced features.

REQUIREMENTS:
- Function takes a canvas ID parameter (canvas will be 500x500px)
- Renders Conway's Game of Life on the provided canvas
- Uses emojis to represent cells with different emojis for different generations
- Includes famous patterns: Glider, Blinker, Gosper Gun, Pulsar (selectable via dropdown)
- Speed control slider (1-10 generations per second)
- Click-to-toggle cells for custom patterns
- "Randomize" and "Clear" buttons
- Aging system where cells change emojis based on survival time
- Death animation with fade-out effect
- Smooth 60 FPS performance
- No external libraries, works in all major browsers

OUTPUT: Valid JavaScript code only. No explanatory text, comments outside code, or markdown formatting.

function startGameOfLife(canvasId){const canvas=document.getElementById(canvasId);canvas.width=500;canvas.height=500;const ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');const cellSize=10;const cols=canvas.width/cellSize;const rows=canvas.height/cellSize;let grid=Array.from({length:rows},()=>Array(cols).fill(0));let dying=[];let speed=5;let genInterval=1000/speed;let lastUpdate=0;const emojis=[{age:1,emoji:'🟢'},{age:3,emoji:'🟡'},{age:5,emoji:'🔴'},{age:Infinity,emoji:'❓'}];const container=document.createElement('div');const patternSelect=document.createElement('select');['None','Glider','Blinker','Gosper Gun','Pulsar'].forEach(name=>{const opt=document.createElement('option');opt.value=name;opt.text=name;patternSelect.appendChild(opt);});const speedSlider=document.createElement('input');speedSlider.type='range';speedSlider.min=1;speedSlider.max=10;speedSlider.value=speed;const speedLabel=document.createElement('span');speedLabel.textContent='Speed: '+speed;const randomBtn=document.createElement('button');randomBtn.textContent='Randomize';const clearBtn=document.createElement('button');clearBtn.textContent='Clear';container.appendChild(patternSelect);container.appendChild(speedLabel);container.appendChild(speedSlider);container.appendChild(randomBtn);container.appendChild(clearBtn);document.body.insertBefore(container,canvas);speedSlider.addEventListener('input',e=>{speed=parseInt(e.target.value);speedLabel.textContent='Speed: '+speed;genInterval=1000/speed;});randomBtn.addEventListener('click',()=>{for(let y=0;y<rows;y++)for(let x=0;x<cols;x++)grid[y][x]=Math.random()<0.2?1:0;});clearBtn.addEventListener('click',()=>{grid=Array.from({length:rows},()=>Array(cols).fill(0));dying=[];});patternSelect.addEventListener('change',e=>{const pattern=e.target.value;if(pattern!=='None'){grid=Array.from({length:rows},()=>Array(cols).fill(0));dying=[];const patterns={'Glider':[[0,0],[1,0],[2,0],[2,1],[1,2]],'Blinker':[[0,1],[1,1],[2,1]],'Gosper Gun':[[0,4],[0,5],[1,4],[1,5],[10,4],[10,5],[10,6],[11,3],[11,7],[12,2],[12,8],[13,2],[13,8],[14,5],[16,0],[16,1],[17,0],[17,1],[18,0],[18,1],[20,3],[20,4],[20,5],[21,2],[21,6],[22,2],[22,6],[24,1],[24,2],[24,3],[24,4],[24,5],[24,6],[24,7],[25,5],[26,4],[26,5],[26,6],[32,2],[32,4],[33,3],[34,3],[35,3],[36,4],[36,6],[37,5],[38,5],[39,4],[39,4],[40,4],[39,3],[40,3],[50,4],[51,5],[50,6],[51,6],[52,5],[53,4],[54,5],[55,5],[57,4],[58,5],[57,6],[58,6],[50,7],[51,8],[52,9],[53,9],[54,10],[55,10],[53,11],[54,10],[55,10]]};const cells=patterns[pattern];const offsetY=Math.floor(rows/2)-Math.floor(Math.max(...cells.map(c=>c[0]))/2);const offsetX=Math.floor(cols/2)-Math.floor(Math.max(...cells.map(c=>c[1]))/2);cells.forEach(([dy,dx])=>{const y=offsetY+dy;const x=offsetX+dx;if(y>=0&&y<rows&&x>=0&&x<cols)grid[y][x]=1;});}});canvas.addEventListener('click',e=>{const rect=canvas.getBoundingClientRect();const x=Math.floor((e.clientX-rect.left)/cellSize);const y=Math.floor((e.clientY-rect.top)/cellSize);if(x>=0&&x<cols&&y>=0&&y<rows){grid[y][x]=grid[y][x]===0?1:0;}});function getNeighbors(y,x){let count=0;for(let dy=-1;dy<=1;dy++)for(let dx=-1;dx<=1;dx++){if(dy===0&&dx===0)continue;const ny=y+dy,nx=x+dx;if(ny>=0&&ny<rows&&nx>=0&&nx<cols)count+=grid[ny][nx]>0?1:0;}return count;}function update(){const newGrid=Array.from({length:rows},()=>Array(cols).fill(0));for(let y=0;y<rows;y++)for(let x=0;x<cols;x++){const age=grid[y][x];if(age>0){const neighbors=getNeighbors(y,x);if(neighbors===2||neighbors===3){newGrid[y][x]=age+1;}}else{const neighbors=getNeighbors(y,x);if(neighbors===3){newGrid[y][x]=1;} else if(grid[y][x]>0){dying.push({x,y,alpha:1});}}}grid=newGrid;}function draw(){ctx.clearRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);ctx.font=`${cellSize}px serif`;ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.textBaseline='middle';for(let y=0;y<rows;y++)for(let x=0;x<cols;x++){const age=grid[y][x];if(age>0){for(const e of emojis){if(age<=e.age){ctx.fillText(e.emoji,(x+0.5)*cellSize,(y+0.5)*cellSize);break;}}}dying.forEach((cell,i)=>{ctx.globalAlpha=cell.alpha;ctx.fillText('🟢',(cell.x+0.5)*cellSize,(cell.y+0.5)*cellSize);cell.alpha-=0.05;if(cell.alpha<=0)dying.splice(i,1);});ctx.globalAlpha=1;}function loop(timestamp){if(timestamp-lastUpdate>=genInterval){update();lastUpdate=timestamp;}draw();requestAnimationFrame(loop);}requestAnimationFrame(loop);}
